title: ApprovalListRow
description: One row emitted by `regatta approval list --format=json`. The whole command emits an array of these. Stable wire contract for downstream operator scripts: a column drift in cmd/regatta must fail schema-check (TestApprovalList_JSONMatchesSchema) before reaching a runtime parser.

approval_id.description: Stable identifier for the approval row in regatta.db.approvals.id.

gate_name.description: Name of the approval_gate that requested this approval. Matches regatta.v1.cue #Gate.name (^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$).

requested_at_unix.description: Unix seconds since epoch at which the approval was requested. UTC; matches state.Approval.RequestedAt.Unix().

timeout_at_unix.description: Unix seconds since epoch after which the reaper applies on_timeout policy. UTC; matches state.Approval.TimeoutAt.Unix().

reviewer_set.description: Snapshot of reviewer ids at request time. Order preserved from the snapshot; downstream tools must not assume sort order.

quorum.description: Number of distinct approving reviewers required for the approval to terminate as approved.
